title: Custodia renews bid for Fed master account in rehearing push at Tenth Circuit
summary: Custodia Bank is asking the full Tenth Circuit Court of Appeals to review the US Fed’s decision denying it a master account, which would allow it to process payments directly.

title: Spain’s regulator sets out MiCA transition rules for crypto platforms
summary: Spain’s securities regulator, CNMV, has spelled out how it plans to run MiCA in practice, using a new Q&A to tell crypto companies what to expect.

title: UK regulator consults on crypto rules for exchanges, lending and DeFi
summary: The UK's FCA launched three consultations on new crypto market rules covering exchanges, staking, lending and DeFi, with feedback due Feb. 12, 2026.

title: Alexander Ray, our partner within the CTDG initiative and a Web3 entrepreneur, co-founder of Albus Protocol and JPool, has passed away
summary: For our team, this is not only the loss of a respected builder in the Web3 space, but the loss of a close and trusted partner.

title: Singapore-licensed StraitsX to bring its SGD, USD stablecoins to Solana in 2026
summary: StraitsX will expand its Singapore dollar and US dollar stablecoins to Solana by early 2026, targeting payments, DeFi and AI use cases.

title: Bitcoin long-term holder supply hits 8-month lows: Bullish or bearish?
summary: The amount of Bitcoin in long-term holder wallets hit cyclical lows, but is it enough to help the bulls avoid a decline toward $68,000?

title: Winklevoss-led Gemini rolls out prediction markets in 50 US states
summary: Gemini says its prediction markets are now live nationwide via affiliate Gemini Titan after it secured a CFTC Designated Contract Market license

title: Bitcoin sharks stack at fastest pace in 13 years, with BTC down 30%
summary: Past record spikes in Bitcoin accumulation preceded major rallies, including a 900% surge in 2012 and a 350% rise in 2011.

title: Most crypto sectors lagged Bitcoin over past 3 months: Glassnode
summary: Bitcoin fell 26% in three months but outperformed most crypto sectors as Ether dropped 36%, AI tokens fell 48%, and memecoins dipped 56%.

title: Ripple pilots RLUSD on Ethereum L2s in multichain push
summary: Ripple is testing RLUSD on layer 2s Optimism, Base, Ink, and Unichain, after the token initially launched on the XRP Ledger and Ethereum in 2024.
